# openwrt_system_led (Resource)

Manages OpenWrt system LED configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) LED name displayed in LuCI.
- `sysfs` (String) LED device path (e.g., 'apu:green:3').

### Optional

- `default` (Boolean) LED enabled by default.
- `dev` (String) Network device for netdev trigger.
- `mode` (String) Trigger mode (e.g., 'link tx rx' for netdev).
- `trigger` (String) Trigger type: 'none', 'netdev', 'timer', 'heartbeat', 'gpio', 'usbdev'.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: system/<led_name>.
- `section` (String) Internal UCI section identifier (e.g. 'cfg0abc12') of the anonymous section backing this resource. Managed automatically; resolved on import.
